image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画上古「涿鹿」（黄帝战蚩尤）。时间传说时代。地点与格局：原始聚落、茅草屋、篝火、石器与陶器、莽莽山川与洪水。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草，纸面淡入，远山与旷野一笔一笔画出。人物：黄帝（轩辕氏）、炎帝（神农氏之后）、蚩尤（九黎之君（后世说））、应龙（神龙）、风伯雨师（神）、魃（天女）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Zhuolu: the Yellow Emperor against Chiyou" in legendary antiquity, 2600 BCE. Place and layout: primitive settlements, thatched huts, bonfires, stone tools and pottery, vast wild mountains and rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass, The paper fades in; distant hills and open plains are drawn stroke by stroke. Figures: Huang Di, Yan Di, Chi You, Ying Long, Feng Boyushi, Ba. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是上古「涿鹿」（黄帝战蚩尤），地点原始聚落、茅草屋、篝火、石器与陶器、莽莽山川与洪水，人物剪影：黄帝（轩辕氏）、炎帝（神农氏之后）、蚩尤（九黎之君（后世说））、应龙（神龙）、风伯雨师（神）、魃（天女）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Zhuolu: the Yellow Emperor against Chiyou" in legendary antiquity, at primitive settlements, thatched huts, bonfires, stone tools and pottery, vast wild mountains and rivers. Silhouettes: Huang Di, Yan Di, Chi You, Ying Long, Feng Boyushi, Ba. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是夏「鸣条」（商汤灭夏），地点夯土台基与宫室、陶器、绿松石器、黄河与伊洛平原，人物剪影：汤（商之君）、桀（夏后）、伊尹（阿衡）、妺喜（桀之宠妃）、仲虺（汤之左相）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Mingtiao: Tang Overthrows the Xia" in the Xia, at rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains. Silhouettes: Tang, Jie, Yi Yin, Mo Xi, Zhong Hui. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Mingtiao: Tang Overthrows the Xia" in the Xia, Tang, Jie, Yi Yin, Mo Xi, Zhong Hui, rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画商「妇好」（女将出征）。时间约前 1250—前 1192 年。地点与格局：夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面，殷都之外，洹水与远山。人物：妇好（武丁之妇）、武丁（商王）、傅说（武丁之相）、祖己（贤臣）、贞人（占卜之官）、羌方（商的西方方国）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Fu Hao, Woman General" in the Shang, 1250 BCE. Place and layout: rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground, Outside the Yin capital, the Huan River and distant hills. Figures: Fu Hao, Wu Ding, Fu Shuo, Zu Ji, Zhen Ren, Qiang Fang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画商「牧野」（武王伐纣）。时间前 1046 年。地点与格局：夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、殿柱、屋檐，商郊，晨雾之中远山与鹿台。人物：周武王（姬发）、师尚父（吕尚，太公望）、纣（帝辛）、周公旦（武王之弟）、微子（纣之庶兄）、妲己（纣之宠妃）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Muye: King Wu Defeats King Zhou" in the Shang, 1046 BCE. Place and layout: rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves, Shang outskirts: distant hills and the Deer Tower in morning mist. Figures: Zhou Wuwang, Shi Shangfu, Zhou, Zhou Gongdan, Wei Zi, Da Ji. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

sound.zh: 声响以战场为线：风卷旌旗、远处马蹄、甲片轻碰、鸦鸣、壁垒上的风。不要枪声，不要爆炸，不要现代车辆。本场地点：夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。
sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画西周「金縢」（周公东征）。时间约前 1042—前 1036 年。地点与格局：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、殿柱、屋檐，丰镐宫中，烛影摇动。人物：周公旦（武王之弟）、周成王（姬诵）、管叔鲜（武王之弟）、蔡叔度（武王之弟）、武庚禄父（纣之子）、召公奭（太保）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Metal Casket: the Duke of Zhou's Eastern Campaign" in the Western Zhou, 1042 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves, Candlelight flickers in the palace at Feng and Hao. Figures: Zhou Gongdan, Zhou Chengwang, Guan Shuxian, Cai Shudu, Wu Genglufu, Shao Gong Shi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是西周「金縢」（周公东征），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：周公旦（武王之弟）、周成王（姬诵）、管叔鲜（武王之弟）、蔡叔度（武王之弟）、武庚禄父（纣之子）、召公奭（太保）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Metal Casket: the Duke of Zhou's Eastern Campaign" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Zhou Gongdan, Zhou Chengwang, Guan Shuxian, Cai Shudu, Wu Genglufu, Shao Gong Shi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：西周「金縢」（周公东征），周公旦（武王之弟）、周成王（姬诵）、管叔鲜（武王之弟）、蔡叔度（武王之弟）、武庚禄父（纣之子）、召公奭（太保），宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "The Metal Casket: the Duke of Zhou's Eastern Campaign" in the Western Zhou, Zhou Gongdan, Zhou Chengwang, Guan Shuxian, Cai Shudu, Wu Genglufu, Shao Gong Shi, ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画西周「南征而不复」（周昭王）。时间约前 977 年，昭王十九年。地点与格局：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、树、树冠，汉水宽阔，南岸是荆楚的山林。人物：周昭王（周王）、祭公（周卿士）、楚子（楚国之君）、管仲（齐相）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The King Who Never Returned: King Zhao" in the Western Zhou, 977 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, trees, tree canopy, The broad Han River, Chu forests on the southern bank. Figures: Zhou Zhaowang, Ji Gong, Chu Zi, Guan Zhong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是西周「南征而不复」（周昭王），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：周昭王（周王）、祭公（周卿士）、楚子（楚国之君）、管仲（齐相）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The King Who Never Returned: King Zhao" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Zhou Zhaowang, Ji Gong, Chu Zi, Guan Zhong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是西周「汧渭之间」（非子养马），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：非子（秦嬴）、周孝王（周王）、申侯（申国之君）、大骆（非子之父）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Between the Qian and Wei: Feizi the Horse Breeder" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Fei Zi, Zhou Xiaowang, Shen Hou, Da Luo. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: cavalry, Xianyun horsemen raise dust on the northern plateau. Figures: Zhou Xuanwang, Yin Jifu, Nan Zhong, Shao Mugong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画西周「烽火」（镐京之变）。时间前 771 年，周幽王十一年。地点与格局：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：近山与地面，骊山之上，烽燧一座。人物：周幽王（姬宫湦）、褒姒（幽王宠妃）、申侯（申国之君）、宜臼（太子，后之周平王）、虢石父（卿士）、犬戎（西戎）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Beacon Fires: the Fall of Hao" in the Western Zhou, 771 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: near hills and ground, A beacon tower on Mount Li. Figures: Zhou Youwang, Bao Si, Shen Hou, Yi Jiu, Guo Shifu, Quan Rong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

sound.zh: 声响以战场为线：风卷旌旗、远处马蹄、甲片轻碰、鸦鸣、壁垒上的风。不要枪声，不要爆炸，不要现代车辆。本场地点：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「尊王攘夷」（齐桓称霸）。时间前 685—前 651 年，齐桓公元年至三十五年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草，临淄城外，旷野长道。人物：齐桓公（小白）、管仲（夷吾）、鲍叔牙（齐大夫）、公子纠（小白之兄）、隰朋（齐大夫）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Honour the King, Repel the Barbarians: Duke Huan of Qi" in the Spring and Autumn period, 685 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass, A long road across the plain outside Linzi. Figures: Qi Huangong, Guan Zhong, Bao Shuya, Gongzi Jiu, Xi Peng. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是春秋「尊王攘夷」（齐桓称霸），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：齐桓公（小白）、管仲（夷吾）、鲍叔牙（齐大夫）、公子纠（小白之兄）、隰朋（齐大夫）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Honour the King, Repel the Barbarians: Duke Huan of Qi" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Qi Huangong, Guan Zhong, Bao Shuya, Gongzi Jiu, Xi Peng. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：春秋「尊王攘夷」（齐桓称霸），齐桓公（小白）、管仲（夷吾）、鲍叔牙（齐大夫）、公子纠（小白之兄）、隰朋（齐大夫），诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Honour the King, Repel the Barbarians: Duke Huan of Qi" in the Spring and Autumn period, Qi Huangong, Guan Zhong, Bao Shuya, Gongzi Jiu, Xi Peng, feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「一鼓作气」（长勺之战）。时间前 684 年，鲁庄公十年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草，长勺原野，两军相望。人物：曹刿（鲁人）、鲁庄公（姬同）、齐桓公（小白）、乡人（曹刿之乡人）、曹沫（鲁将（《史记·刺客列传》））。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "One Drum Roll of Courage: the Battle of Changshao" in the Spring and Autumn period, 684 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass, The field of Changshao, two armies facing each other. Figures: Cao Gui, Lu Zhuanggong, Qi Huangong, Xiang Ren, Cao Mo. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是春秋「一鼓作气」（长勺之战），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：曹刿（鲁人）、鲁庄公（姬同）、齐桓公（小白）、乡人（曹刿之乡人）、曹沫（鲁将（《史记·刺客列传》））。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "One Drum Roll of Courage: the Battle of Changshao" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Cao Gui, Lu Zhuanggong, Qi Huangong, Xiang Ren, Cao Mo. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是春秋「泓水之战」（宋襄公之仁），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：宋襄公（宋君兹甫）、目夷（宋司马子鱼，襄公庶兄）、成得臣（楚将子玉）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Battle of the Hong River: Duke Xiang's Benevolence" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Song Xianggong, Mu Yi, Cheng Dechen. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「退避三舍」（城濮之战）。时间前 632 年，晋文公五年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草，十九年流亡之路，远山连绵。人物：晋文公（重耳）、子玉（成得臣，楚令尹）、楚成王（熊恽）、狐偃（子犯，重耳之舅）、胥臣（晋大夫）、介之推（随亡之臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Retreating Three Stages: the Battle of Chengpu" in the Spring and Autumn period, 632 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass, Nineteen years of exile along endless hills. Figures: Jin Wengong, Zi Yu, Chu Chengwang, Hu Yan, Xu Chen, Jie Zhitui. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「弦高犒师」（殽之战）。时间前 627 年四月，鲁僖公三十三年，秦穆公三十三年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：蹇叔，秦都城门外，一位老人拉住出征的儿子。人物：弦高（郑国商人）、孟明视（秦帅）、蹇叔（秦大夫）、秦穆公（秦君）、先轸（晋中军将）、文嬴（晋文公夫人，秦女）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Xian Gao Feeds the Army: the Battle of Xiao" in the Spring and Autumn period, 627 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: Jian Shu, At the Qin gate an old man holds back his son who is marching out. Figures: Xian Gao, Meng Mingshi, Jian Shu, Qin Mugong, Xian Zhen, Wen Ying. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「卧薪尝胆」（吴越争霸）。时间前 494—前 473 年，越王勾践三年至二十四年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、草，太湖烟水，远山如眉。人物：勾践（越王）、夫差（吴王）、范蠡（越大夫）、文种（越大夫）、伍子胥（吴大夫）、西施（越女）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Sleeping on Brushwood, Tasting Gall: Wu and Yue" in the Spring and Autumn period, 494 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass, Mist over Lake Tai, hills like eyebrows. Figures: Gou Jian, Fu Cha, Fan Li, Wen Zhong, Wu Zixu, Xi Shi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是春秋「卧薪尝胆」（吴越争霸），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：勾践（越王）、夫差（吴王）、范蠡（越大夫）、文种（越大夫）、伍子胥（吴大夫）、西施（越女）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Sleeping on Brushwood, Tasting Gall: Wu and Yue" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Gou Jian, Fu Cha, Fan Li, Wen Zhong, Wu Zixu, Xi Shi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Sleeping on Brushwood, Tasting Gall: Wu and Yue" in the Spring and Autumn period, Gou Jian, Fu Cha, Fan Li, Wen Zhong, Wu Zixu, Xi Shi, feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「伏尸而射」（吴起之死）。时间前 381 年，楚悼王二十一年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：吴起、骑兵，郢都城外，吴起骑马巡视新开的田地，身后跟着被迁出封地的贵族车队。人物：吴起（卫人，兵家，楚令尹）、楚悼王（楚君）、楚肃王（悼王之子）、楚国贵戚（失去封禄的宗室大臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Shielded by a Corpse: The Death of Wu Qi" in the Warring States, 381 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: Wu Qi, cavalry, Outside Ying, Wu Qi rides past newly opened fields, trailed by the carts of nobles moved off their fiefs. Figures: Wu Qi, Chu Daowang, Chu Suwang, Chu Guoguiqi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是战国「伏尸而射」（吴起之死），地点列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简，人物剪影：吴起（卫人，兵家，楚令尹）、楚悼王（楚君）、楚肃王（悼王之子）、楚国贵戚（失去封禄的宗室大臣）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Shielded by a Corpse: The Death of Wu Qi" in the Warring States, at capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. Silhouettes: Wu Qi, Chu Daowang, Chu Suwang, Chu Guoguiqi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Shielded by a Corpse: The Death of Wu Qi" in the Warring States, Wu Qi, Chu Daowang, Chu Suwang, Chu Guoguiqi, capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是战国「围魏救赵」（桂陵与马陵），地点列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简，人物剪影：孙膑（齐军师）、庞涓（魏将）、田忌（齐将）、齐威王（田因齐）、太子申（魏太子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Besiege Wei to Save Zhao: Guiling and Maling" in the Warring States, at capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. Silhouettes: Sun Bin, Pang Juan, Tian Ji, Qi Weiwang, Tai Zishen. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「胡服骑射」（赵武灵王）。时间前 307—前 295 年，赵武灵王十九年至赵惠文王四年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：骑兵，北边草原，胡骑往来。人物：赵武灵王（赵雍）、公子成（武灵王叔父）、肥义（赵相）、赵惠文王（赵何）、公子章（安阳君）、李兑（赵臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Nomad Dress and Mounted Archery: King Wuling of Zhao" in the Warring States, 307 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: cavalry, Nomad horsemen ride across the northern steppe. Figures: Zhao Wulingwang, Gongzi Cheng, Fei Yi, Zhao Huiwenwang, Gongzi Zhang, Li Dui. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「火牛阵」（田单复齐）。时间前 284—前 279 年，燕昭王二十八年至燕惠王元年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟，齐地七十余城相继陷落，只剩莒与即墨。人物：田单（即墨守将）、乐毅（燕上将军）、骑劫（燕将）、燕惠王（燕王）、齐襄王（田法章）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Fire Oxen: Tian Dan Restores Qi" in the Warring States, 284 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke, Over seventy Qi cities fall until only Ju and Jimo remain. Figures: Tian Dan, Yue Yi, Qi Jie, Yan Huiwang, Qi Xiangwang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「纸上谈兵」（长平之战）。时间前 260 年，秦昭王四十七年，赵孝成王六年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：河水，上党山地，丹水之滨。人物：白起（武安君，秦将）、赵括（赵将，赵奢之子）、廉颇（赵将）、王龁（秦将）、赵孝成王（赵丹）、赵括之母（赵奢之妻）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Strategy on Paper: the Battle of Changping" in the Warring States, 260 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river, The Shangdang highlands by the Dan River. Figures: Bai Qi, Zhao Kuo, Lian Po, Wang He, Zhao Xiaochengwang, Zhao Kuozhimu. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是战国「纸上谈兵」（长平之战），地点列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简，人物剪影：白起（武安君，秦将）、赵括（赵将，赵奢之子）、廉颇（赵将）、王龁（秦将）、赵孝成王（赵丹）、赵括之母（赵奢之妻）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Strategy on Paper: the Battle of Changping" in the Warring States, at capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. Silhouettes: Bai Qi, Zhao Kuo, Lian Po, Wang He, Zhao Xiaochengwang, Zhao Kuozhimu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Strategy on Paper: the Battle of Changping" in the Warring States, Bai Qi, Zhao Kuo, Lian Po, Wang He, Zhao Xiaochengwang, Zhao Kuozhimu, capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「易水寒」（荆轲刺秦王）。时间前 227 年，秦王政二十年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：大面积留白，只有淡墨远山，纸面淡入，远山一笔一笔画出，竖排题字。人物：荆轲（燕太子丹门客·刺客）、太子丹（燕太子）、田光（燕处士）、鞠武（太子丹之傅）、樊於期（秦亡将）、秦舞阳（荆轲副手）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Cold Waters of the Yi: Jing Ke Attempts to Kill the King of Qin" in the Warring States, 227 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: mostly empty paper with faint distant hills, The paper fades in, hills drawn stroke by stroke, vertical title. Figures: Jing Ke, Tai Zidan, Tian Guang, Ju Wu, Fan Yuqi, Qin Wuyang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Cold Waters of the Yi: Jing Ke Attempts to Kill the King of Qin" in the Warring States, at capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. Silhouettes: Jing Ke, Tai Zidan, Tian Guang, Ju Wu, Fan Yuqi, Qin Wuyang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是秦「徐福东渡」（入海求仙），地点咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆，人物剪影：徐福（徐市，齐方士）、秦始皇（嬴政）、卢生（燕方士）、伍被（淮南王门客）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Xu Fu Sails East in Search of Immortals" in the Qin, at Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. Silhouettes: Xu Fu, Qin Shi Huang, Lu Sheng, Wu Bei. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画秦「博浪一击」（张良）。时间前 218 年，秦始皇二十九年。地点与格局：咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：沙、草，阳武县外，黄沙漫道。人物：张良（韩国公子之后）、力士（仓海君所荐）、秦始皇（皇帝）、圯上老人（黄石公）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Place and layout: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: sand, grass, Yellow sand on the road outside Yangwu. Figures: Zhang Liang, Li Shi, Qin Shi Huang, Yi Shanglaoren. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画秦「王侯将相宁有种乎」（大泽乡）。时间前 209 年，秦二世元年七月。地点与格局：咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：洪水；题字「雨」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势，大泽乡，雨连日不止。人物：陈胜（屯长）、吴广（屯长）、将尉（押送戍卒的秦吏）、扶苏（长公子（已死））、项燕（楚将（已死））。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Are Kings and Nobles Born to It? Dazexiang" in the Qin, 209 BCE. Place and layout: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script.  Figures: Chen Sheng, Wu Guang, Jiang Wei, Fu Su, Xiang Yan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画秦「斩蛇起沛」（刘季）。时间前 209 年九月，秦二世元年九月。地点与格局：咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、月；中景：草、河水，丰西的大泽，夜色里芦苇起伏。人物：刘季（泗水亭长）、萧何（沛主吏掾）、曹参（沛狱掾）、樊哙（屠狗者）、沛令（沛县县令）、吕雉（刘季之妻）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Killing the Serpent at Pei: Liu Ji" in the Qin, 209 BCE. Place and layout: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, moon; midground: grass, river, In the great marsh west of Feng reeds sway in the dark. Figures: Liu Ji, Xiao He, Cao Can, Fan Kuai, Pei Ling, Lü Zhi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是秦「斩蛇起沛」（刘季），地点咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆，人物剪影：刘季（泗水亭长）、萧何（沛主吏掾）、曹参（沛狱掾）、樊哙（屠狗者）、沛令（沛县县令）、吕雉（刘季之妻）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Killing the Serpent at Pei: Liu Ji" in the Qin, at Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. Silhouettes: Liu Ji, Xiao He, Cao Can, Fan Kuai, Pei Ling, Lü Zhi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：秦「斩蛇起沛」（刘季），刘季（泗水亭长）、萧何（沛主吏掾）、曹参（沛狱掾）、樊哙（屠狗者）、沛令（沛县县令）、吕雉（刘季之妻），咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Killing the Serpent at Pei: Liu Ji" in the Qin, Liu Ji, Xiao He, Cao Can, Fan Kuai, Pei Ling, Lü Zhi, Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画秦「破釜沉舟」（巨鹿之战）。时间前 207 年，秦二世三年。地点与格局：咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞，漳水，巨鹿城外。人物：项羽（楚上将军）、宋义（卿子冠军）、章邯（秦将）、王离（秦将）、苏角（秦将）、涉间（秦将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Breaking the Cauldrons, Sinking the Boats: Julu" in the Qin, 207 BCE. Place and layout: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall, The Zhang River outside Julu. Figures: Xiang Yu, Song Yi, Zhang Han, Wang Li, Su Jiao, She Jian. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是秦「破釜沉舟」（巨鹿之战），地点咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆，人物剪影：项羽（楚上将军）、宋义（卿子冠军）、章邯（秦将）、王离（秦将）、苏角（秦将）、涉间（秦将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Breaking the Cauldrons, Sinking the Boats: Julu" in the Qin, at Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. Silhouettes: Xiang Yu, Song Yi, Zhang Han, Wang Li, Su Jiao, She Jian. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Breaking the Cauldrons, Sinking the Boats: Julu" in the Qin, Xiang Yu, Song Yi, Zhang Han, Wang Li, Su Jiao, She Jian, Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「月下追韩信」（暗度陈仓），地点未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队，人物剪影：韩信（淮阴人）、萧何（丞相）、刘邦（汉王）、夏侯婴（滕公）、章邯（雍王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Chasing Han Xin by Moonlight: Secret Crossing to Chencang" in the Western Han, at Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. Silhouettes: Han Xin, Xiao He, Liu Bang, Xiahou Ying, Zhang Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「背水一战」（井陉）。时间汉三年十月，汉三年冬十月。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：近山与地面，太行山中，井陉口狭道。人物：韩信（汉大将）、张耳（汉将）、陈馀（成安君）、李左车（广武君）、赵王歇（赵王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Back to the River: Jingxing" in the Western Han, 204 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: near hills and ground, In the Taihang mountains, the narrow pass of Jingxing. Figures: Han Xin, Zhang Er, Chen Yu, Li Zuoche, Zhao Wangxie. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「四面楚歌」（垓下）。时间前 202 年，汉五年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、营帐，垓下，营垒数重。人物：项羽（西楚霸王）、虞姬（项羽之美人）、刘邦（汉王）、韩信（齐王）、灌婴（汉骑将）、乌江亭长（亭长）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Chu Songs on All Sides: Gaixia" in the Western Han, 202 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, army tents, Gaixia, ramparts layer upon layer. Figures: Xiang Yu, Yu Ji, Liu Bang, Han Xin, Guan Ying, Wu Jiangtingzhang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「白登之围」（平城七日）。时间前 200 年，汉高祖七年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；主体：军阵、长兵如林；题字「雪」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势，冬天大寒雨雪，士卒堕指者十之二三。人物：汉高祖（刘邦）、冒顿单于（匈奴单于）、陈平（护军中尉）、刘敬（娄敬）、阏氏（单于之妻）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Siege of Baideng: Seven Days at Pingcheng" in the Western Han, 200 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.  Figures: Han Gaozu, Modu Chanyu, Chen Ping, Liu Jing, Yanzhi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「白登之围」（平城七日），地点未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队，人物剪影：汉高祖（刘邦）、冒顿单于（匈奴单于）、陈平（护军中尉）、刘敬（娄敬）、阏氏（单于之妻）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Siege of Baideng: Seven Days at Pingcheng" in the Western Han, at Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. Silhouettes: Han Gaozu, Modu Chanyu, Chen Ping, Liu Jing, Yanzhi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "The Siege of Baideng: Seven Days at Pingcheng" in the Western Han, Han Gaozu, Modu Chanyu, Chen Ping, Liu Jing, Yanzhi, Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「七国之乱」（周亚夫）。时间前 154 年，汉景帝三年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟，关东诸国，烽火并起。人物：周亚夫（太尉）、汉景帝（刘启）、晁错（御史大夫）、吴王濞（刘濞）、袁盎（太常）、赵涉（谋士）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Rebellion of the Seven States: Zhou Yafu" in the Western Han, 154 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke, Beacon fires flare across the eastern states. Figures: Zhou Yafu, Han Jingdi, Chao Cuo, Wu Wangbi, Yuan Ang, Zhao She. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.
