video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是隋「渡江」（隋灭陈），地点大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱，人物剪影：隋文帝（杨坚）、杨广（晋王，伐陈元帅）、韩擒虎（庐州总管）、贺若弼（吴州总管）、陈叔宝（陈后主）、张丽华（贵妃）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Crossing the River: Sui Conquers Chen" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Sui Wendi, Yang Guang, Han Qinhu, He Ruobi, Chen Shubao, Zhang Lihua. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画隋「三征高句丽」（萨水之败）。时间612—614 年，隋大业八年至十年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：军阵、长兵如林，辽水东西，大军百万。人物：隋炀帝（杨广）、宇文述（左翊卫大将军）、于仲文（右翊卫大将军）、乙支文德（高句丽大臣）、杨玄感（礼部尚书）、王薄（长白山义军首领）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Three Campaigns Against Goguryeo: Disaster at the Salsu" in the Sui, 612 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, A million troops on both sides of the Liao River. Figures: Sui Yangdi, Yuwen Shu, Yu Zhongwen, Eulji Mundeok, Yang Xuangan, Wang Bao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画隋「雁门之围」（疑兵）。时间615 年八至九月，隋大业十一年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：骑兵，雁门关外，突厥骑兵漫山遍野。人物：杨广（隋炀帝）、始毕可汗（东突厥可汗）、义成公主（隋宗室女，嫁突厥）、李世民（应募少年）、云定兴（屯卫将军）、萧瑀（内史侍郎）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Siege of Yanmen: Phantom Army" in the Sui, 615 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: cavalry, Turkic horsemen cover the hills beyond Yanmen Pass. Figures: Yang Guang, Shibi Qaghan, Princess Yicheng, Li Shimin, Yun Dingxing, Xiao Yu. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Siege of Yanmen: Phantom Army" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Yang Guang, Shibi Qaghan, Princess Yicheng, Li Shimin, Yun Dingxing, Xiao Yu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画隋「瓦岗」（群雄并起）。时间616—618 年，隋大业十二年至唐武德元年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草、河水，瓦岗寨，运河边的荒原。人物：李密（魏公）、翟让（瓦岗首领）、秦琼（瓦岗将领）、程知节（瓦岗将领）、单雄信（瓦岗将领）、张须陀（隋将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Wagang: Rebels Rise Everywhere" in the Sui, 616 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, river, Wagang stronghold on the wasteland by the canal. Figures: Li Mi, Zhai Rang, Qin Qiong, Cheng Zhijie, Shan Xiongxin, Zhang Xutuo. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是隋「瓦岗」（群雄并起），地点大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱，人物剪影：李密（魏公）、翟让（瓦岗首领）、秦琼（瓦岗将领）、程知节（瓦岗将领）、单雄信（瓦岗将领）、张须陀（隋将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Wagang: Rebels Rise Everywhere" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Li Mi, Zhai Rang, Qin Qiong, Cheng Zhijie, Shan Xiongxin, Zhang Xutuo. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Wagang: Rebels Rise Everywhere" in the Sui, Li Mi, Zhai Rang, Qin Qiong, Cheng Zhijie, Shan Xiongxin, Zhang Xutuo, Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Hulao: Two Kings Captured in One Battle" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「玄武门之变」（武德九年）。时间626 年，唐武德九年六月。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、关门，长安宫城，北门玄武。人物：李世民（秦王，后之唐太宗）、李建成（太子）、李元吉（齐王）、尉迟敬德（秦王府将）、唐高祖（李渊）、长孙无忌（秦王府僚）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Xuanwu Gate Incident" in the Tang, 626 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, gate, The northern Xuanwu Gate of the Chang'an palace. Figures: Li Shimin, Li Jiancheng, Li Yuanji, Yuchi Jingde, Tang Gaozu, Zhangsun Wuji. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「渭水之盟」（李靖破突厥）。时间626—630 年，唐武德九年至贞观四年。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：骑兵，渭水北岸，突厥骑兵连营。人物：唐太宗（李世民）、颉利可汗（东突厥可汗）、李靖（定襄道行军总管）、李勣（通汉道行军总管）、房玄龄（中书令）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Wei River Pact: Li Jing Defeats the Turks" in the Tang, 626 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: cavalry, Turkic camps on the north bank of the Wei. Figures: Tang Taizong, Illig Qaghan, Li Jing, Li Ji, Fang Xuanling. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「渭水之盟」（李靖破突厥），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：唐太宗（李世民）、颉利可汗（东突厥可汗）、李靖（定襄道行军总管）、李勣（通汉道行军总管）、房玄龄（中书令）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Wei River Pact: Li Jing Defeats the Turks" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Tang Taizong, Illig Qaghan, Li Jing, Li Ji, Fang Xuanling. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「怛罗斯」（高仙芝西征）。时间751 年，唐玄宗天宝十载。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：高仙芝、军阵、旌旗、长兵如林，葱岭以西的草原，唐军三万人马向西行进了七百多里。人物：高仙芝（安西四镇节度使）、李嗣业（右威卫将军）、葛逻禄（随唐军出征的突厥部族）、杜环（唐军士卒，杜佑族子）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Talas: Gao Xianzhi's Western Campaign" in the Tang, 751 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: Gao Xianzhi, army ranks, banners, forest of spears, On the steppe west of the Pamirs thirty thousand Tang troops march more than seven hundred li. Figures: Gao Xianzhi, Li Siye, Ge Luolu, Du Huan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「怛罗斯」（高仙芝西征），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：高仙芝（安西四镇节度使）、李嗣业（右威卫将军）、葛逻禄（随唐军出征的突厥部族）、杜环（唐军士卒，杜佑族子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Talas: Gao Xianzhi's Western Campaign" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Gao Xianzhi, Li Siye, Ge Luolu, Du Huan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Talas: Gao Xianzhi's Western Campaign" in the Tang, Gao Xianzhi, Li Siye, Ge Luolu, Du Huan, Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「六渡扶桑」（鉴真东渡），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：鉴真（扬州大明寺律师）、荣睿（日本留学僧）、普照（日本留学僧）、思托（鉴真弟子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Six Crossings to Japan: Jianzhen Sails East" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Jian Zhen, Rong Rui, Pu Zhao, Si Tuo. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「睢阳」（张巡与许远）。时间756—757 年，唐天宝十五载至至德二载。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞；主体：盾墙，睢阳城，江淮门户。人物：张巡（河南节度副使）、许远（睢阳太守）、南霁云（张巡部将）、雷万春（张巡部将）、尹子琦（安庆绪部将）、贺兰进明（河南节度使）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Suiyang: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan" in the Tang, 756 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall; subject: shield wall, Suiyang, gateway to the Yangtze–Huai region. Figures: Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun, Lei Wanchun, Yin Ziqi, He Lanjinming. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「雪夜入蔡州」（李愬）。时间817 年十月，唐元和十二年十月。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草、城墙雉堞，淮西平野，三年攻战。人物：李愬（唐邓随节度使）、吴元济（淮西叛帅）、李祐（淮西降将）、裴度（宰相、淮西宣慰处置使）、唐宪宗（李纯）、韩愈（行军司马）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Into Caizhou on a Snowy Night: Li Su" in the Tang, 817 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, crenellated city wall, Three years of war on the Huaixi plain. Figures: Li Su, Wu Yuanji, Li You, Pei Du, Tang Xianzong, Han Yu. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「冲天香阵」（黄巢入长安）。时间875—884 年，唐乾符二年至中和四年。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：众人，灾荒之年，盐道上的人群。人物：黄巢（冲天大将军，大齐皇帝）、王仙芝（起事首领）、朱温（黄巢部将）、李克用（沙陀首领）、唐僖宗（李儇）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "A Heaven-Piercing Fragrance: Huang Chao Takes Chang'an" in the Tang, 875 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: crowd, Crowds on the salt roads in a year of famine. Figures: Huang Chao, Wang Xianzhi, Zhu Wen, Li Keyong, Tang Xizong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「冲天香阵」（黄巢入长安），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：黄巢（冲天大将军，大齐皇帝）、王仙芝（起事首领）、朱温（黄巢部将）、李克用（沙陀首领）、唐僖宗（李儇）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "A Heaven-Piercing Fragrance: Huang Chao Takes Chang'an" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Huang Chao, Wang Xianzhi, Zhu Wen, Li Keyong, Tang Xizong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "A Heaven-Piercing Fragrance: Huang Chao Takes Chang'an" in the Tang, Huang Chao, Wang Xianzhi, Zhu Wen, Li Keyong, Tang Xizong, Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是五代十国「三矢」（李存勖），地点汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇，人物剪影：李存勖（后唐庄宗）、李克用（晋王）、朱温（后梁太祖）、景进（伶人）、郭从谦（从马直指挥使）、李嗣源（蕃汉总管）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Three Arrows: Li Cunxu" in the Five Dynasties, at Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons. Silhouettes: Li Cunxu, Li Keyong, Zhu Wen, Jing Jin, Guo Congqian, Li Siyuan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画五代十国「高平之战」（周世宗）。时间954 年三月，后周显德元年三月。地点与格局：汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草，泽州高平，巴公原。人物：柴荣（周世宗）、赵匡胤（宿卫将）、张永德（殿前都虞候）、刘崇（北汉主）、樊爱能（马军都指挥使）、冯道（太师）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Battle of Gaoping: Emperor Shizong of Zhou" in the Five Dynasties, 954 CE. Place and layout: Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass, Bagong plain at Gaoping in Zezhou. Figures: Chai Rong, Zhao Kuangyin, Zhang Yongde, Liu Chong, Fan Aineng, Feng Dao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画五代十国「黄袍加身」（陈桥兵变）。时间960 年，后周显德七年，宋建隆元年。地点与格局：汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞；题字「雪」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势，开封城，正月。人物：赵匡胤（殿前都点检，后之宋太祖）、赵普（归德军掌书记）、赵光义（赵匡胤之弟）、周恭帝（柴宗训）、符太后（周世宗皇后）、石守信（殿前都指挥使）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Yellow Robe: the Chenqiao Mutiny" in the Five Dynasties, 960 CE. Place and layout: Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons.  Figures: Zhao Kuangyin, Zhao Pu, Zhao Guangyi, Zhou Gongdi, Empress Dowager Fu, Shi Shouxin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「澶渊之盟」（景德元年）。时间1004—1005 年，宋景德元年至二年。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞，黄河两岸，澶州南北二城。人物：宋真宗（赵恒）、寇准（宰相）、萧太后（萧绰，承天太后）、辽圣宗（耶律隆绪）、萧挞凛（辽统军）、曹利用（使臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Treaty of Chanyuan" in the Northern Song, 1004 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall, The two towns of Chanzhou on either bank of the Yellow River. Figures: Song Zhenzong, Kou Zhun, Empress Dowager Xiao, Liao Shengzong, Xiao Talin, Cao Liyong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是北宋「澶渊之盟」（景德元年），地点汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿，人物剪影：宋真宗（赵恒）、寇准（宰相）、萧太后（萧绰，承天太后）、辽圣宗（耶律隆绪）、萧挞凛（辽统军）、曹利用（使臣）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Treaty of Chanyuan" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Song Zhenzong, Kou Zhun, Empress Dowager Xiao, Liao Shengzong, Xiao Talin, Cao Liyong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "The Treaty of Chanyuan" in the Northern Song, Song Zhenzong, Kou Zhun, Empress Dowager Xiao, Liao Shengzong, Xiao Talin, Cao Liyong, Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是北宋「好水川」（李元昊），地点汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿，人物剪影：李元昊（夏景宗）、韩琦（陕西安抚副使）、范仲淹（陕西经略安抚副使）、任福（泾原路行营总管）、桑怿（泾原路都监）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Haoshui River: Li Yuanhao" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Li Yuanhao, Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, Ren Fu, Sang Yi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「夜夺昆仑关」（狄青）。时间1053 年正月，皇祐五年正月。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、关门，宾州城外，昆仑关隐在群山间。人物：狄青（宣徽南院使、荆湖南北路宣抚使）、侬智高（广源州首领）、孙沔（广南安抚使）、余靖（广南西路安抚使）、陈曙（广西钤辖）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Seizing Kunlun Pass by Night: Di Qing" in the Northern Song, 1053 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, gate, Kunlun Pass hidden in hills outside Binzhou. Figures: Di Qing, Nong Zhigao, Sun Mian, Yu Jing, Chen Shu. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「靖康之变」（二帝北迁）。时间1126—1127 年，宋靖康元年至二年。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、河水，汴京，繁华的街市。人物：宋徽宗（赵佶）、宋钦宗（赵桓）、李纲（亲征行营使）、完颜宗望（金东路军统帅）、完颜宗翰（金西路军统帅）、郭京（自称能施六甲法者）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Jingkang Disaster: Two Emperors Taken North" in the Northern Song, 1126 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, river, Bustling streets of Bianjing. Figures: Song Huizong, Song Qinzong, Li Gang, Wanyan Zongwang, Wanyan Zonghan, Guo Jing. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Jingkang Disaster: Two Emperors Taken North" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Song Huizong, Song Qinzong, Li Gang, Wanyan Zongwang, Wanyan Zonghan, Guo Jing. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「契丹建国」（耶律阿保机）。时间916 年二月，神册元年二月。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草、河水、营帐，潢河之畔，契丹八部牙帐。人物：耶律阿保机（辽太祖）、述律平（应天皇后）、耶律剌葛（阿保机之弟）、耶律倍（皇太子）、大諲譔（渤海末王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Founding the Khitan State: Yelü Abaoji" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 916 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, river, army tents, Tents of the eight Khitan tribes by the Huang River. Figures: Yelü Abaoji, Shu Lüping, Yelü Lage, Yelü Bei, Da Yinzhuan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是辽 · 西夏 · 金「契丹建国」（耶律阿保机），地点草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原，人物剪影：耶律阿保机（辽太祖）、述律平（应天皇后）、耶律剌葛（阿保机之弟）、耶律倍（皇太子）、大諲譔（渤海末王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Founding the Khitan State: Yelü Abaoji" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. Silhouettes: Yelü Abaoji, Shu Lüping, Yelü Lage, Yelü Bei, Da Yinzhuan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Founding the Khitan State: Yelü Abaoji" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, Yelü Abaoji, Shu Lüping, Yelü Lage, Yelü Bei, Da Yinzhuan, steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是辽 · 西夏 · 金「护步答冈」（阿骨打起兵），地点草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原，人物剪影：完颜阿骨打（女真首领，金太祖）、辽天祚帝（耶律延禧）、完颜吴乞买（阿骨打之弟，后之金太宗）、完颜宗翰（粘罕，金将）、耶律章奴（辽将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Hubudagang: Aguda Rises in Revolt" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. Silhouettes: Wanyan Aguda, Liao Tianzuodi, Wanyan Wuqimai, Wanyan Zonghan, Yelü Zhangnu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「黄河九渡」（西夏亡）。时间1227 年六至七月，蒙古太祖二十二年，夏宝义二年。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：骑兵，黄河两岸，蒙古骑兵分路渡河。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古太祖）、李睍（西夏末主）、耶律楚材（随军文臣）、古尔伯勒津（西夏王妃（传说人物））。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Nine Crossings of the Yellow River: the Fall of Western Xia" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 1227 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: cavalry, Mongol cavalry cross the Yellow River at several points. Figures: Genghis Khan, Li Xian, Yelü Chucai, Gürbeljin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「蔡州」（金亡）。时间1233—1234 年，金天兴二年至三年。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟，汴京已破，哀宗南走。人物：金哀宗（完颜守绪）、完颜承麟（金末帝）、孟珙（宋将）、塔察儿（蒙古将领）、忠孝军将士（金军）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Caizhou: the Fall of Jin" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 1233 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke, Bianjing has fallen; Emperor Aizong flees south. Figures: Jin Aizong, Wanyan Chenglin, Meng Gong, Tachar, Zhong Xiaojunjiangshi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「过河」（宗泽）。时间1127—1128 年，宋建炎元年至二年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：城墙雉堞、烟；主体：盾墙，靖康之后的东京，城墙残破，街巷空寂。人物：宗泽（东京留守）、岳飞（宗泽部下）、王善（河东义军首领）、赵构（宋高宗）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Cross the River: Zong Ze" in the Southern Song, 1127 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: shield wall, After Jingkang, Kaifeng's walls are broken and its streets empty. Figures: Zong Ze, Yue Fei, Wang Shan, Zhao Gou. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「过河」（宗泽），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：宗泽（东京留守）、岳飞（宗泽部下）、王善（河东义军首领）、赵构（宋高宗）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Cross the River: Zong Ze" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Zong Ze, Yue Fei, Wang Shan, Zhao Gou. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「黄天荡」（韩世忠与梁夫人），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：韩世忠（浙西制置使）、梁夫人（韩世忠之妻）、完颜宗弼（兀术，金军统帅）、献策者（福建人王某）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Huangtiandang: Han Shizhong and Lady Liang" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Han Shizhong, Lady Liang, Wanyan Zongbi, Xian Cezhe. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "Huangtiandang: Han Shizhong and Lady Liang" in the Southern Song, Han Shizhong, Lady Liang, Wanyan Zongbi, Xian Cezhe, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「精忠」（岳飞）。时间1140—1142 年，宋绍兴十年至十一年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、草，中原故土，黄河南岸。人物：岳飞（少保，河南北诸路招讨使）、岳云（岳飞之子）、秦桧（宰相）、宋高宗（赵构）、完颜宗弼（兀术，金都元帅）、韩世忠（枢密使）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Loyal to the End: Yue Fei" in the Southern Song, 1140 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass, The lost heartland south of the Yellow River. Figures: Yue Fei, Yue Yun, Qin Gui, Song Gaozong, Wanyan Zongbi, Han Shizhong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「采石矶」（虞允文）。时间1161 年十一月，宋绍兴三十一年十一月。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：山石剪影；中景：河水、近山与地面，采石矶，长江最窄处之一。人物：虞允文（中书舍人、督视府参谋军事）、完颜亮（金主）、时俊（统制）、王权（建康都统制）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Caishi Cliff: Yu Yunwen" in the Southern Song, 1161 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: rock silhouettes; midground: river, near hills and ground, Caishi, one of the narrowest points of the Yangtze. Figures: Yu Yunwen, Wanyan Liang, Shi Jun, Wang Quan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

This shot is "Caishi Cliff: Yu Yunwen" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Yu Yunwen, Wanyan Liang, Shi Jun, Wang Quan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「五十骑」（辛弃疾）。时间1162 年，宋绍兴三十二年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：营帐、近山与地面；主体：旌旗，山东，耿京义军营地。人物：辛弃疾（耿京掌书记）、耿京（天平军节度使）、张安国（叛将）、义端（僧人）、王世隆（统制）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Fifty Horsemen: Xin Qiji" in the Southern Song, 1162 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: midground: army tents, near hills and ground; subject: banners, Geng Jing's rebel camp in Shandong. Figures: Xin Qiji, Geng Jing, Zhang Anguo, Yi Duan, Wang Shilong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「五十骑」（辛弃疾），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：辛弃疾（耿京掌书记）、耿京（天平军节度使）、张安国（叛将）、义端（僧人）、王世隆（统制）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Fifty Horsemen: Xin Qiji" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Xin Qiji, Geng Jing, Zhang Anguo, Yi Duan, Wang Shilong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「函首」（开禧北伐与韩侂胄），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：韩侂胄（平章军国事）、史弥远（礼部侍郎）、杨皇后（宋宁宗皇后）、夏震（权主管殿前司公事）、吴曦（四川宣抚副使）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Head in a Box: The Kaixi Campaign and Han Tuozhou" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Han Tuozhou, Shi Miyuan, Empress Yang, Xia Zhen, Wu Xi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "The Head in a Box: The Kaixi Campaign and Han Tuozhou" in the Southern Song, Han Tuozhou, Shi Miyuan, Empress Yang, Xia Zhen, Wu Xi, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「钓鱼城」（上帝折鞭）。时间1243—1279 年，宋淳祐三年至祥兴二年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：河水，合州，嘉陵江、渠江、涪江三江交汇。人物：余玠（四川制置使）、冉琎（播州士人）、王坚（钓鱼城守将）、蒙哥（蒙古大汗）、王立（钓鱼城末任守将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Diaoyu Fortress: Where the Scourge of God Broke His Whip" in the Southern Song, 1243 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river, Hezhou, where three rivers meet. Figures: Yu Jie, Ran Jin, Wang Jian, Möngke, Wang Li. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「襄樊之战」（吕文焕）。时间1273 年正月，宋咸淳九年正月。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：河水、城墙雉堞；主体：盾墙，汉水两岸，襄阳与樊城隔江相望。人物：吕文焕（知襄阳府）、阿术（元军统帅）、刘整（元水军将领）、张顺（民兵部辖）、张贵（民兵都统）、亦思马因（回回炮匠）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "The Battle of Xiangfan: Lü Wenhuan" in the Southern Song, 1273 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: midground: river, crenellated city wall; subject: shield wall, Xiangyang and Fancheng face each other across the Han. Figures: Lü Wenhuan, A Shu, Liu Zheng, Zhang Shun, Zhang Gui, Ismail. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「襄樊之战」（吕文焕），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：吕文焕（知襄阳府）、阿术（元军统帅）、刘整（元水军将领）、张顺（民兵部辖）、张贵（民兵都统）、亦思马因（回回炮匠）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "The Battle of Xiangfan: Lü Wenhuan" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Lü Wenhuan, A Shu, Liu Zheng, Zhang Shun, Zhang Gui, Ismail. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「崖山」（文天祥）。时间1279—1283 年，宋祥兴二年至元至元十九年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：江海、浪头，南海，崖门两山对峙。人物：文天祥（右丞相）、陆秀夫（左丞相）、张世杰（枢密副使）、赵昺（宋帝昺）、张弘范（元军统帅）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "Yashan: Wen Tianxiang" in the Southern Song, 1279 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: sea, breaking waves, Twin hills of the Yamen strait on the South China Sea. Figures: Wen Tianxiang, Lu Xiufu, Zhang Shijie, Zhao Bing, Zhang Hongfan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「崖山」（文天祥），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：文天祥（右丞相）、陆秀夫（左丞相）、张世杰（枢密副使）、赵昺（宋帝昺）、张弘范（元军统帅）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "Yashan: Wen Tianxiang" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Wen Tianxiang, Lu Xiufu, Zhang Shijie, Zhao Bing, Zhang Hongfan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.
