image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "函谷" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Hangu Pass.  Figures: Chuli Ji. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. scenes.title: 河西四郡
scenes.subtitle: 断匈奴右臂
scenes.narrative: 元狩二年霍去病出陇西、过焉支，匈奴浑邪王降汉，河西走廊空出。汉朝随后设酒泉、武威，后又设张掖、敦煌，合称河西四郡。设郡的年份不完全在同一年，《汉书·武帝纪》和《地理志》把过程写在元狩到元鼎之间。本场取走廊落入汉朝版图的这一步：四座郡城沿着祁连和沙漠排开。漠北大战是军事场。

sources.title: 汉书
sources.notes: 元狩二年匈奴浑邪王降

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「河西四郡」（断匈奴右臂）。时间前 121 年，汉武帝元狩二年。地点与格局：河西、酒泉、敦煌。人物：霍去病（骠骑将军）、浑邪王（匈奴王）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "河西四郡" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Hexi corridor.  Figures: Huo Qubing, King Hunye. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「河西四郡」（断匈奴右臂），地点河西、酒泉、敦煌，人物剪影：霍去病（骠骑将军）、浑邪王（匈奴王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "河西四郡" in the Western Han, at the Hexi corridor. Silhouettes: Huo Qubing, King Hunye. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「河西四郡」（断匈奴右臂）。时间前 121 年，汉武帝元狩二年。地点与格局：河西、酒泉、敦煌。人物：霍去病（骠骑将军）、浑邪王（匈奴王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "河西四郡" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Hexi corridor.  Figures: Huo Qubing, King Hunye. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「河西四郡」（断匈奴右臂），地点河西、酒泉、敦煌，人物剪影：霍去病（骠骑将军）、浑邪王（匈奴王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "河西四郡" in the Western Han, at the Hexi corridor. Silhouettes: Huo Qubing, King Hunye. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "河西四郡" in the Western Han, Huo Qubing, King Hunye, the Hexi corridor. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 南四郡
scenes.subtitle: 赤壁之后的地图
scenes.narrative: 赤壁之后，刘备表刘琦为荆州刺史，自己南征武陵、长沙、桂阳、零陵四郡，四郡皆降。刘琦死，刘备领荆州牧，孙权把南郡借给他。《三国志·先主传》写的是这场领土变化。赤壁是火与船。本场是火灭之后的地图：长江以南的四郡落到刘备手里，南郡的归属却要靠借。这张图决定了后来的荆州争端。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「南四郡」（赤壁之后的地图）。时间209 年，汉建安十四年。地点与格局：武陵、长沙、桂阳、零陵。人物：刘备（领荆州牧）、孙权（吴主）、刘琦（荆州刺史）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "南四郡" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: the four southern commanderies.  Figures: Liu Bei, Sun Quan, Liu Qi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Figures: Liu Bei, Sun Quan, Liu Qi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. scenes.title: 六镇
scenes.subtitle: 北边的军镇
scenes.narrative: 北魏在平城时代沿北边设沃野、怀朔、武川、抚冥、柔玄、怀荒等镇，用来防柔然。迁都洛阳之后，镇人的地位下降。正光四年破六韩拔陵在沃野镇起兵，六镇相继崩溃。《魏书·肃宗纪》记了起兵，地理格局则要连着《地形志》和后来的追述一起看。本场画六座沿着草原南缘排列的镇城，洛阳的宫廷远在南边。

sources.title: 魏书
sources.notes: 正光四年沃野镇破六韩拔陵起兵

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「六镇」（北边的军镇）。时间523 年，北魏正光四年。地点与格局：沃野、怀朔、武川。人物：破六韩拔陵（沃野镇民）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "六镇" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: the Six Garrisons.  Figures: Poliuhan Baling. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南北朝「六镇」（北边的军镇），地点沃野、怀朔、武川，人物剪影：破六韩拔陵（沃野镇民）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "六镇" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at the Six Garrisons. Silhouettes: Poliuhan Baling. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 安西四镇
scenes.subtitle: 龟兹
scenes.narrative: 显庆三年，唐把安西都护府从西州迁到龟兹，统领龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆四镇。四镇后来多次因吐蕃而弃、又恢复，不是一次设置就永远安定。《旧唐书·地理志》记录了都护府和四镇的名字。玄奘走过的是更早的路。本场画塔里木南缘和北缘的四座城，以及把它们连到长安的一条细线。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「安西四镇」（龟兹）。时间658 年，唐显庆三年。地点与格局：龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆。人物：唐高宗（唐帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "安西四镇" in the Tang. Place and layout: the Four Garrisons of Anxi.  Figures: Emperor Gaozong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「安西四镇」（龟兹）。时间658 年，唐显庆三年。地点与格局：龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆。人物：唐高宗（唐帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "安西四镇" in the Tang. Place and layout: the Four Garrisons of Anxi.  Figures: Emperor Gaozong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「安西四镇」（龟兹），地点龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆，人物剪影：唐高宗（唐帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "安西四镇" in the Tang, at the Four Garrisons of Anxi. Silhouettes: Emperor Gaozong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 塘泺
scenes.subtitle: 河北水网
scenes.narrative: 宋朝打不过辽的骑兵，何承矩建议在河北边缘开塘泊，把水连成一片，使骑兵不能直冲。《宋史·河渠志》记了淳化以后白洋淀一带塘泺的经营。这是用地理缺陷来补军力：把平原改成浅水。澶渊之盟是城下的政治。本场只画一条沿边界展开的水面和水面后面的宋军营垒。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「塘泺」（河北水网）。时间993 年，宋淳化四年。地点与格局：河北、塘泺。人物：何承矩（河北屯田使）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "塘泺" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: the Hebei ponds.  Figures: He Chengju. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是北宋「塘泺」（河北水网），地点河北、塘泺，人物剪影：何承矩（河北屯田使）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "塘泺" in the Northern Song, at the Hebei ponds. Silhouettes: He Chengju. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：北宋「塘泺」（河北水网），何承矩（河北屯田使），河北、塘泺。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "塘泺" in the Northern Song, He Chengju, the Hebei ponds. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "塘泺" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: the Hebei ponds.  Figures: He Chengju. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 熙河
scenes.subtitle: 王韶开边
scenes.narrative: 王韶向神宗建议先取洮河一带的蕃部，再图西夏。熙宁五年他在熙河用兵，收复熙、河、洮、岷等州，设熙河路。《宋史·王韶传》写了这次开边的成功和后来的争议。它改变的是北宋西北的地图，不只是一次战斗的胜负。本场画洮河和新建的一路，不把好水川的败仗画在同一张图上。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「熙河」（王韶开边）。时间1072 年，宋熙宁五年。地点与格局：熙州、河州、洮河。人物：王韶（秦凤路经略）、宋神宗（宋帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "熙河" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Xihe and the Tao River.  Figures: Wang Shao, Emperor Shenzong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「熙河」（王韶开边）。时间1072 年，宋熙宁五年。地点与格局：熙州、河州、洮河。人物：王韶（秦凤路经略）、宋神宗（宋帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "熙河" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Xihe and the Tao River.  Figures: Wang Shao, Emperor Shenzong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是北宋「熙河」（王韶开边），地点熙州、河州、洮河，人物剪影：王韶（秦凤路经略）、宋神宗（宋帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "熙河" in the Northern Song, at Xihe and the Tao River. Silhouettes: Wang Shao, Emperor Shenzong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "熙河" in the Northern Song, Wang Shao, Emperor Shenzong, Xihe and the Tao River. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 延绥边墙
scenes.subtitle: 余子俊
scenes.narrative: 成化十年，延绥巡抚余子俊在黄土高原的北边修筑边墙，把营堡移到墙内，用来阻挡河套的骑兵。《明史·余子俊传》写了这次工程的长度和他与朝中反对者的争执。明长城不是一条一次修成的线，延绥这一段是其中有明确主持人的一段。本场画黄土梁上的墙和墙内的堡，不把秦长城和它画成同一道。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「延绥边墙」（余子俊）。时间1474 年，明成化十年。地点与格局：延绥、榆林。人物：余子俊（延绥巡抚）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "延绥边墙" in the Ming. Place and layout: Yansui and Yulin.  Figures: Yu Zijun. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "延绥边墙" in the Ming, at Yansui and Yulin. Silhouettes: Yu Zijun. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「延绥边墙」（余子俊）。时间1474 年，明成化十年。地点与格局：延绥、榆林。人物：余子俊（延绥巡抚）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "延绥边墙" in the Ming. Place and layout: Yansui and Yulin.  Figures: Yu Zijun. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 辽西走廊
scenes.subtitle: 山海之间的关

when.notes: 筑关之年方志多系洪武十四年，本场取约数，以地理志所载关隘为准。

scenes.narrative: 山海关在辽西走廊的最窄处，一边是山，一边是海。《明史·地理志》把它系在永平府抚宁县下，是明朝对辽东和蒙古方向的主要关口。吴三桂开关是崇祯十七年的事，已有专场。本场只画这座关的地形：山、海和中间只能通过一支军队的城门。不把“天下第一关”的匾写进画面，字是后来加的。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 洪武中修北边关隘，山海关之筑系于此时，年份取约

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关）。时间约洪武十四年，明洪武十四年前后。地点与格局：山海关、辽西走廊。人物：徐达（明将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "辽西走廊" in the Ming. Place and layout: Shanhai Pass.  Figures: Xu Da. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关），地点山海关、辽西走廊，人物剪影：徐达（明将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "辽西走廊" in the Ming, at Shanhai Pass. Silhouettes: Xu Da. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "辽西走廊" in the Ming, Xu Da, Shanhai Pass. One rise and fall, then rest.

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关），地点山海关、辽西走廊，人物剪影：徐达（明将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "辽西走廊" in the Ming, at Shanhai Pass. Silhouettes: Xu Da. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 伊犁
scenes.subtitle: 新疆的枢纽
scenes.narrative: 乾隆二十到二十四年，清朝平定准部和回部，在伊犁设将军，总统天山南北的军政。《清史稿·地理志》把伊犁写成新疆的重心，惠远城是将军驻地。左宗棠收复是一百多年后的事。本场画伊犁河谷和从那里伸向塔里木、伸向蒙古的路，说明十八世纪中叶清朝的地图在这里收了一个结。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 乾隆二十四年平定回部

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽）。时间1759 年，清乾隆二十四年。地点与格局：伊犁、惠远。人物：乾隆帝（清帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "伊犁" in the Qing. Place and layout: Ili and Huiyuan.  Figures: Qianlong Emperor. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽）。时间1759 年，清乾隆二十四年。地点与格局：伊犁、惠远。人物：乾隆帝（清帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "伊犁" in the Qing. Place and layout: Ili and Huiyuan.  Figures: Qianlong Emperor. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽），地点伊犁、惠远，人物剪影：乾隆帝（清帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "伊犁" in the Qing, at Ili and Huiyuan. Silhouettes: Qianlong Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 吴宫教战
scenes.subtitle: 孙武

when.era: 吴王阖闾三年前后（年号未行）
when.notes: 《史记》系于阖闾用孙武，不记月日。

scenes.narrative: 《史记·孙子吴起列传》说孙武以兵法见阖闾，阖闾用宫中美女试他的束伍。孙武三令五申之后斩了两名队长，队伍才听鼓进退。阖闾先心疼宠姬，后来仍用他为将。斩姬的戏剧性很强，史公写进列传，本场保留这个文本，同时不把它扩张成小说里的剑阵。吴宫是人物场：一个把军法用在王的亲近身上的人。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 孙武以兵法见吴王，小试勒兵

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画春秋「吴宫教战」（孙武）。时间约前 512 年，吴王阖闾三年前后（年号未行）。地点与格局：吴宫。人物：孙武（吴将）、阖闾（吴王）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "吴宫教战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: the Wu palace.  Figures: Sun Wu, Helü. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 膑脚
scenes.subtitle: 孙膑与庞涓

when.era: 齐威王、魏惠王之间（年号未行）
when.notes: 膑脚之年不可考，取在桂陵之前。

scenes.narrative: 《史记·孙子吴起列传》说孙膑与庞涓同学兵法，庞涓在魏国得志，把孙膑骗来，处以膑刑。孙膑后来装疯，被齐国使者藏在车里带回齐国，才有桂陵和马陵。马陵的伏击已有专场。本场停在刑余和出逃：一个不能走路的人被藏进使车。不把后世兵书上的名字都算成他的原著。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画战国「膑脚」（孙膑与庞涓）。时间约前 4 世纪，齐威王、魏惠王之间（年号未行）。地点与格局：大梁、临淄。人物：孙膑（刑余）、庞涓（魏将）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "膑脚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Daliang and Linzi.  Figures: Sun Bin, Pang Juan. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. This shot is "膑脚" in the Warring States, at Daliang and Linzi. Silhouettes: Sun Bin, Pang Juan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「膑脚」（孙膑与庞涓）。时间约前 4 世纪，齐威王、魏惠王之间（年号未行）。地点与格局：大梁、临淄。人物：孙膑（刑余）、庞涓（魏将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "膑脚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Daliang and Linzi.  Figures: Sun Bin, Pang Juan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "膑脚" in the Warring States, at Daliang and Linzi. Silhouettes: Sun Bin, Pang Juan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 义不帝秦
scenes.subtitle: 鲁仲连

when.era: 秦昭襄王四十九年前后（年号未行）
when.notes: 邯郸围城期间，取前 258 年。

scenes.narrative: 邯郸被围时，魏国派新垣衍劝赵尊秦为帝，以求罢兵。鲁仲连在平原君处见他，说秦如果称帝，自己就跳东海而死，也不会做它的百姓。新垣衍不敢再提。《史记·鲁仲连邹阳列传》把这段写成辩难，不是战斗。围城和窃符是另外的场。本场只留席间的三个人和一封没有发出的“帝秦”之议。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画战国「义不帝秦」（鲁仲连）。时间前 258 年，秦昭襄王四十九年前后（年号未行）。地点与格局：邯郸。人物：鲁仲连（齐人）、新垣衍（魏使）、平原君（赵公子）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "义不帝秦" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Handan.  Figures: Lu Zhonglian, Xin Yuan Yan, Lord Pingyuan. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. scenes.title: 蒙恬之死
scenes.subtitle: 罪固当死
scenes.narrative: 始皇在沙丘死后，赵高、李斯改诏，赐扶苏、蒙恬死。扶苏自杀。蒙恬疑心，被关在阳周，后来还是吞药。他临死说自己修长城、起临洮，可能惊动了地脉。《史记·蒙恬列传》记下这段自责，司马迁又批评他把罪过归于地脉、而不说拒绝进谏。长城工地已有专场。本场只在阳周的监狱：一个将领和一封假诏。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画秦「蒙恬之死」（罪固当死）。时间前 210 年，秦始皇三十七年。地点与格局：阳周。人物：蒙恬（秦将）、扶苏（公子）、赵高（中车府令）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "蒙恬之死" in the Qin. Place and layout: Yangzhou prison.  Figures: Meng Tian, Fusu, Zhao Gao. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画秦「蒙恬之死」（罪固当死）。时间前 210 年，秦始皇三十七年。地点与格局：阳周。人物：蒙恬（秦将）、扶苏（公子）、赵高（中车府令）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "蒙恬之死" in the Qin. Place and layout: Yangzhou prison.  Figures: Meng Tian, Fusu, Zhao Gao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "蒙恬之死" in the Qin, at Yangzhou prison. Silhouettes: Meng Tian, Fusu, Zhao Gao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "蒙恬之死" in the Qin, Meng Tian, Fusu, Zhao Gao, Yangzhou prison. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 骑奴
scenes.subtitle: 卫青微时

when.notes: 卫青为骑奴的年份在被封侯之前，取元光中。

scenes.narrative: 卫青是平阳侯家的骑奴，母亲卫媪是侯家的婢。他的姐姐卫子夫得幸武帝之后，卫青才从奴仆变成太中大夫，再一步步做到大将军。《史记·卫将军骠骑列传》开篇就写这段出身。收河南地和封狼居胥是他后来的战争。本场停在平阳侯府的马厩：一个还没有军阵的人。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 卫青少为平阳侯家骑奴

Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "骑奴" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Pingyang. scenes.title: 匈奴未灭
scenes.subtitle: 霍去病
scenes.narrative: 霍去病十八岁为剽姚校尉，两次深入匈奴，封狼居胥。武帝给他造府第，他回答：匈奴未灭，无以家为。元狩六年他死，年不满二十四。《史记》把这句话和早死写在一起。漠北大战是战役场。本场是人：一个不肯接受宅第、很快死去的青年将领。画面只有空着的府第和远去的骑队。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 匈奴未灭，无以家为；元狩六年卒

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「匈奴未灭」（霍去病）。时间前 117 年，汉武帝元狩六年。地点与格局：长安。人物：霍去病（骠骑将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "匈奴未灭" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Chang'an.  Figures: Huo Qubing, Emperor Wu of Han. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. This shot is "匈奴未灭" in the Western Han, at Chang'an. Silhouettes: Huo Qubing, Emperor Wu of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「匈奴未灭」（霍去病）。时间前 117 年，汉武帝元狩六年。地点与格局：长安。人物：霍去病（骠骑将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "匈奴未灭" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Chang'an.  Figures: Huo Qubing, Emperor Wu of Han. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「匈奴未灭」（霍去病），地点长安，人物剪影：霍去病（骠骑将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "匈奴未灭" in the Western Han, at Chang'an. Silhouettes: Huo Qubing, Emperor Wu of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "匈奴未灭" in the Western Han, Huo Qubing, Emperor Wu of Han, Chang'an. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 东山
scenes.subtitle: 谢安

when.notes: 谢安出山在升平年间，取约数，早于淝水。

scenes.narrative: 谢安早年高卧东山，朝廷屡次征召都不就。直到弟弟谢万兵败、家族需要人，他才出来做官，后来一直做到指挥淝水之战。《晋书·谢安传》把东山写成他一生的前半。淝水是战役场。本场只画会稽的山和一顶还没有戴上的进贤冠。不把围棋赌墅提前到隐居的时候。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「东山」（谢安）。时间约 360 年，东晋升平中。地点与格局：东山。人物：谢安（隐士）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "东山" in the Jin. Place and layout: Dongshan.  Figures: Xie An. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。这一场是两晋「东山」（谢安），地点东山，人物剪影：谢安（隐士）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. This shot is "东山" in the Jin, at Dongshan. Silhouettes: Xie An. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画两晋「东山」（谢安）。时间约 360 年，东晋升平中。地点与格局：东山。人物：谢安（隐士）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "东山" in the Jin. Place and layout: Dongshan.  Figures: Xie An. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 长乐王
scenes.subtitle: 窦建德
scenes.narrative: 窦建德在河北起兵，大业十三年在乐寿称长乐王。他的军队纪律相对严，打仗也时常亲自上阵。武德年间他救王世充，在虎牢被李世民俘获，那是唐初的另一场。本场停在隋末的乐寿：一个从农民军里出来、还没有碰到虎牢的人。《旧唐书·窦建德传》从这里写起。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 大业十三年称长乐王于乐寿

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画隋「长乐王」（窦建德）。时间617 年，隋大业十三年。地点与格局：乐寿。人物：窦建德（长乐王）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "长乐王" in the Sui. Place and layout: Leshhou.  Figures: Dou Jiande. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. This shot is "长乐王" in the Sui, at Leshhou. Silhouettes: Dou Jiande. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 寇准
scenes.subtitle: 少年登第
scenes.narrative: 寇准十九岁中进士。宋太宗想用他做知县，有人说他太年轻，太宗说他和当年的颜回差不多大。《宋史·寇准传》从这里写起。澶渊城里逼真宗过河，是他中年的事，已有专场。本场只留殿试之后的一个年轻人，还没有莱国公的爵位。不把京剧里的寇准脸谱画进去。

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 太平兴国五年进士，年十九

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「寇准」（少年登第）。时间980 年，宋太平兴国五年。地点与格局：汴京。人物：寇准（进士）、宋太宗（宋帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "寇准" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Bianjing.  Figures: Kou Zhun, Emperor Taizong of Song. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 闯王
scenes.subtitle: 李自成入京
scenes.narrative: 李自成从陕西的驿卒变成闯王，崇祯十七年春天进入北京。崇祯在煤山自缢，那是皇帝的一场。本场跟着李自成：进城、拷掠明朝官员追饷、自己在武英殿称帝，随即听说山海关兵败，匆忙离京。《明史·流贼传》写了入城后的失序，不是一份英雄榜。画面停在空了的紫禁城门和准备离京的车。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 崇祯十七年李自成入京师

scenes.title: 阪泉之战
scenes.subtitle: 黄帝与炎帝

when.display: 传说时代，传统排在涿鹿之前
when.notes: 阪泉、涿鹿的地望与公元年都没有可靠纪年，年份只用于排序。

scenes.narrative: 《史记·五帝本纪》把黄帝和炎帝的冲突写在涿鹿大战之前：两国在阪泉之野打了三仗，黄帝才压服炎帝一系。这是上古战争传说里少有的“同姓联盟内部开战”，不是对蚩尤那种外敌。三战的打法、阵法和地点，司马迁没有细写，后世地图上的阪泉有涿鹿附近等几种附会。本场只取正史这一句的规模：两支部族军阵相持，不把龙、雾和应龙写进正史线。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 黄帝与炎帝战于阪泉之野，三战然后得其志

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画上古「阪泉之战」（黄帝与炎帝）。时间传说时代，传统排在涿鹿之前，传说时代（年号未行）。地点与格局：阪泉。人物：黄帝（部族首领）、炎帝（部族首领）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "阪泉之战" in legendary antiquity. Place and layout: Banquan.  Figures: Huangdi, Yandi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "阪泉之战" in legendary antiquity, at Banquan. Silhouettes: Huangdi, Yandi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 甘之战
scenes.subtitle: 启伐有扈

when.era: 夏启在位之初（年号未行）
when.notes: 甘地所在有户县、郑州等说，本场不锁定今地。

scenes.narrative: 禹死之后，启把位子留在自家里，有扈氏不答应。启在甘地誓师，《甘誓》用很重的话责备对方扰乱时令、不遵正朔，叫六卿在战车上听鼓进、听锣退。这一仗是“家天下”第一次靠大战来压不服的人。正史记下了誓师和胜负的政治意义，没有留下阵图。战场篇只画车阵和鼓，不把后世演义里的神兽加进去。

sources.title: 尚书
sources.notes: 启与有扈大战于甘的誓辞

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 有扈氏不服，启伐之，大战于甘

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画夏「甘之战」（启伐有扈）。时间约前 2070 年，夏启在位之初（年号未行）。地点与格局：甘。人物：启（夏后）、有扈氏（敌对部族）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "甘之战" in the Xia. Place and layout: Gan.  Figures: Qi of Xia, Youhu. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 高宗伐鬼方
scenes.subtitle: 三年克之

when.notes: 《周易》只说三年克之，没有公元年。

scenes.narrative: 武丁在殷墟卜辞和后世追述里都是一位把战争打到很远的商王。《周易·既济》留下一句极短的战报：高宗伐鬼方，三年才打下来。《史记·殷本纪》写武丁修政行德、殷道复兴，没有展开这场战争的地形。鬼方究竟在晋陕还是更北，学界仍在争。本场取“长期对北的苦战”这一正史和易传能站住的核心，不把妇好伐羌方和这一场混成一件事。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画商「高宗伐鬼方」（三年克之）。时间约前 13 世纪，武丁在位（年号未行）。地点与格局：鬼方。人物：武丁（商王）、鬼方（敌对部族）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "高宗伐鬼方" in the Shang. Place and layout: the Guifang frontier.  Figures: Wu Ding, Guifang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 千亩之战
scenes.subtitle: 败于姜戎

when.era: 周宣王三十九年（年号未行）
when.notes: 宣王元年按前 827 年计，三十九年为前 789 年。

scenes.narrative: 周宣王前期还有“中兴”的名声，晚岁却在千亩被姜氏之戎打垮，连调来的“南国之师”也折了。《史记·周本纪》把这一仗和宣王此后不修籍田、败于申侯之祸连在一起看：西周的兵力从这里开始不够用。千亩的位置有山西、关中两说，本场只把它当作戎人熟悉、王师不熟的一块坡地。和宣王早年对玁狁的反击不是同一场。

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是西周「千亩之战」（败于姜戎），地点千亩，人物剪影：周宣王（周天子）、姜氏之戎（敌对部族）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "千亩之战" in the Western Zhou, at Qianmu. Silhouettes: King Xuan of Zhou, Jiang Rong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 鞍之战
scenes.subtitle: 齐晋车战

when.era: 周定王十八年 · 鲁成公二年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 晋国郤克出使齐国时受了辱，两年后齐晋在鞍开战。齐顷公轻敌，说“余姑翦灭此而后朝食”，马还没有披甲就冲出去。晋军以郤克为中军，却在他受伤后仍把战车赶进齐阵。逢丑父和顷公换了位置，顷公才逃回。这是春秋车战的典型一仗：胜负系于中军的鼓和御者，不系于后来的骑兵画像。《左传》把对话和伤情写得很细，本场用它，不用汉以后的演义。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「鞍之战」（齐晋车战）。时间前 589 年，周定王十八年 · 鲁成公二年（年号未行）。地点与格局：鞍。人物：郤克（晋中军帅）、齐顷公（齐君）、逢丑父（齐卿）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "鞍之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: An.  Figures: Xi Ke, Duke Qing of Qi, Feng Choufu. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "鞍之战" in the Spring and Autumn period, at An. Silhouettes: Xi Ke, Duke Qing of Qi, Feng Choufu. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 邲之战
scenes.subtitle: 晋楚争霸

when.era: 周定王十年 · 鲁宣公十二年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 楚庄王围郑，郑降。晋国荀林父把大军带到黄河边，内部对渡河意见分裂，部分部队先过了河，主帅只好跟着渡。楚军在邲打垮这支阵脚不稳的晋军，晋人夜里抢船，船上砍断攀着船舷的手指。庄王没有穷追，还禁止把晋尸堆成京观。这一仗说明城濮之后晋楚的均势反过来了，也说明主帅压不住自己的偏师就会崩。本场和城濮之战是两次不同的晋楚决战。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 庄王十七年败晋师于河上

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「邲之战」（晋楚争霸）。时间前 597 年，周定王十年 · 鲁宣公十二年（年号未行）。地点与格局：邲、黄河。人物：楚庄王（楚君）、荀林父（晋中军帅）、孙叔敖（楚令尹）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "邲之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: Bi, on the Yellow River.  Figures: King Zhuang of Chu, Xun Linfu, Sunshu Ao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.
