scenes.title: 柏举之战
scenes.subtitle: 吴师入郢

when.era: 周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 吴王阖闾用伍子胥、孙武，从淮水一线西进，在柏举大破楚令尹囊瓦的军队，接着五战五胜，攻进郢都。楚昭王出逃。吴人在郢的暴行和后来秦国出兵救楚、吴师退走，都写在《左传》定公四年、五年。这一仗把长江中游的霸权从楚国手里打出一条缝，也是孙武之名进入史书战争记载的关键一役。本场画汉水以东的军阵和空了的郢都，不把西施故事掺进来。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢）。时间前 506 年，周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：柏举、郢。人物：阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: Boju and Ying.  Figures: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢）。时间前 506 年，周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：柏举、郢。人物：阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: Boju and Ying.  Figures: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 伊阙之战
scenes.subtitle: 白起破韩魏

when.era: 周赧王二十二年 · 秦昭襄王十四年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 伊阙在洛阳南，是韩魏挡秦国东出的口子。秦昭襄王用白起，在这里击破韩魏联军。《史记·白起列传》记下了极大的斩首数字，用来说明白起从此被封为武安君、秦军开始以歼灭战闻名。数字本身是汉代史书的记载，本场不把它画成屠场，只保留关口、两支援军互相观望、秦军从中间撕开的格局。韩魏从此不敢再轻易合兵塞住伊阙。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 昭王十四年，白起攻韩、魏于伊阙

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 昭襄王十四年，白起攻韩、魏于伊阙

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「伊阙之战」（白起破韩魏）。时间前 293 年，周赧王二十二年 · 秦昭襄王十四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：伊阙。人物：白起（秦将）、韩釐王（韩君）、魏冉（秦相）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "伊阙之战" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Yique.  Figures: Bai Qi, King Xi of Han, Wei Ran. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 济西之战
scenes.subtitle: 乐毅伐齐

when.era: 周赧王三十一年 · 燕昭王二十八年（年号未行）
when.notes: 燕昭王元年传统系于前 311 年，二十八年为前 284 年。

scenes.narrative: 燕昭王为了报复齐国早年的入侵，筑黄金台招揽乐毅。乐毅联合秦、楚、三晋，在济西击破齐军，随即长驱，下齐城七十余座，只剩下莒和即墨。齐湣王出逃，后来死在莒。这一仗和后来田单的火牛复齐是同一场战争的两头：先是齐国几乎亡国，再是即墨的翻盘。本场只写济西的会战和空城，火牛留给已有的田单一场。

sources.title: 史记

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是战国「济西之战」（乐毅伐齐），地点济西，人物剪影：乐毅（燕上将军）、燕昭王（燕君）、齐湣王（齐君）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "济西之战" in the Warring States, at west of the Ji River. Silhouettes: Yue Yi, King Zhao of Yan, King Min of Qi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 王翦灭楚
scenes.subtitle: 六十万

when.era: 秦王政二十三年（年号未行）
when.notes: 秦王政元年为前 246 年，二十三年为前 224 年；次年虏负刍。

scenes.narrative: 秦王政想迅速灭楚，先听李信说二十万够了，李信被楚军击败。王翦坚持非六十万不可，得到兵权后却按兵不动，让士卒投石超距，等楚军松懈再出击，追到蕲南，杀项燕，次年虏楚王负刍。司马迁把重点放在用兵的耐心，而不是一夜破城。楚地大、粮道长，所以这是一场以休整和追击写成的灭国之战。和后来项羽的楚不是同一个楚。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 王翦率六十万灭楚，杀项燕

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 二十三年，王翦虏楚王负刍

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「王翦灭楚」（六十万）。时间前 224 年，秦王政二十三年（年号未行）。地点与格局：蕲南、楚。人物：王翦（秦将）、秦王政（秦王）、项燕（楚将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Qinan, in Chu.  Figures: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画战国「王翦灭楚」（六十万）。时间前 224 年，秦王政二十三年（年号未行）。地点与格局：蕲南、楚。人物：王翦（秦将）、秦王政（秦王）、项燕（楚将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Qinan, in Chu.  Figures: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States, at Qinan, in Chu. Silhouettes: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 围邯郸
scenes.subtitle: 平原君在围城

when.era: 秦昭襄王五十年（年号未行）
when.notes: 长平在前 260 年，邯郸围解在前 257 年。

scenes.narrative: 长平之后秦军围邯郸，赵国几乎被困死。平原君向楚、魏求救，门客毛遂在楚王面前把合纵说成，楚国才出兵。魏国晋鄙的救兵停在荡阴，不敢进。围城本身是一场粮尽、拆屋、守垛的苦战，解围要等魏楚兵到。信陵君窃符是同一围城的另一条线，已有专场。本场站在邯郸城头：赵孝成王、平原君和几乎出不去的使团。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「围邯郸」（平原君在围城）。时间前 257 年，秦昭襄王五十年（年号未行）。地点与格局：邯郸。人物：平原君（赵公子）、毛遂（赵客）、赵孝成王（赵君）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "围邯郸" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Handan.  Figures: Lord Pingyuan, Mao Sui, King Xiaocheng of Zhao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 彭城之战
scenes.subtitle: 项羽回师

when.notes: 汉元年为前 206 年。

scenes.narrative: 刘邦趁项羽北上齐地，率诸侯兵进入彭城。项羽只带三万骑连夜赶回，从早晨打到中午，汉军大溃，掉进穀水和泗水的人很多。刘邦只和几十骑逃出，路上连子女都推下车。司马迁用这一仗说明：占领都城不等于赢得会战，回师的一方可以更致命。本场画彭城外的尘土和向北的骑队，不画后来戏台上的项王。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 项羽以三万骑破汉军于彭城

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 汉二年四月，项羽击汉军于彭城

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「彭城之战」（项羽回师）。时间前 205 年，汉王二年（年号未行）。地点与格局：彭城、泗水。人物：项羽（西楚霸王）、刘邦（汉王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "彭城之战" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Pengcheng and the Si River.  Figures: Xiang Yu, Liu Bang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 潍水之战
scenes.subtitle: 韩信破齐
scenes.narrative: 韩信已经用计拿下齐地，楚国派龙且来救。有人劝龙且深壁，让齐人自己反汉，龙且不听，要速战。韩信在潍水上游用沙囊堵住水，军半渡时撤囊，楚军被冲散，龙且被杀。齐地从此归汉。这一仗常被看成韩信用地形打的最干净的一仗：不是硬碰，是把河变成武器。本场的主线是潍水和两岸的军阵。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「潍水之战」（韩信破齐）。时间前 203 年，汉王四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：潍水。人物：韩信（汉将）、龙且（楚将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "潍水之战" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Wei River in Qi.  Figures: Han Xin, Long Ju. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「潍水之战」（韩信破齐），地点潍水，人物剪影：韩信（汉将）、龙且（楚将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "潍水之战" in the Western Han, at Wei River in Qi. Silhouettes: Han Xin, Long Ju. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "潍水之战" in the Western Han, Han Xin, Long Ju, Wei River in Qi. One rise and fall, then rest.

This shot is "潍水之战" in the Western Han, at Wei River in Qi. Silhouettes: Han Xin, Long Ju. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 收河南地
scenes.subtitle: 卫青出云中
scenes.narrative: 元朔二年，卫青出云中，沿黄河北岸向西打到陇西，赶走匈奴白羊、楼烦王，把秦朝丢掉的“河南地”收回来，汉朝在那里设朔方郡。这是漠北大战之前的一次收复，意义在地图：匈奴失去了南下威胁长安的跳板。司马迁写卫青这次“走白羊、楼烦王”，不写一场有名字的对阵厮杀。本场以河套的空旷和新建的障塞为主。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中）。时间前 127 年，汉武帝元朔二年。地点与格局：河南地、云中、朔方。人物：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "收河南地" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Ordos bend.  Figures: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中）。时间前 127 年，汉武帝元朔二年。地点与格局：河南地、云中、朔方。人物：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "收河南地" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Ordos bend.  Figures: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 灭南越
scenes.subtitle: 楼船与伏波
scenes.narrative: 南越相吕嘉杀汉使、立新王。元鼎六年，路博德为伏波将军，杨仆为楼船将军，分兵出桂阳、豫章、零陵和巴蜀，会师番禺。番禺城火起后，吕嘉夜间逃出，被追获。南越从此设为汉郡。这是一场沿江、沿海的远征，不是中原车战。本场画楼船、江雾和番禺的城郭，不把汉代还没有的海图仪器画进去。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 元鼎六年楼船、伏波灭南越

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「灭南越」（楼船与伏波）。时间前 111 年，汉武帝元鼎六年。地点与格局：番禺、离水。人物：路博德（伏波将军）、杨仆（楼船将军）、吕嘉（南越相）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "灭南越" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Panyu.  Figures: Lu Bode, Yang Pu, Lü Jia. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "灭南越" in the Western Han, at Panyu. Silhouettes: Lu Bode, Yang Pu, Lü Jia. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 铜马
scenes.subtitle: 刘秀在河北

when.notes: 更始是淮阳王刘玄的年号，不在后来的东汉年号序列里。

scenes.narrative: 更始把刘秀放到河北，名义上是安抚，实际上中原已经是各路农民军的地盘。刘秀在鄡和铜马等部反复较量，被迫投降的人仍不放心，他亲自在营中骑马按行，铜马的人才说“萧王推赤心置人腹中”。这一仗让他获得后来打天下的基本兵力，也是昆阳大捷之后、称帝之前的关键战役。本场不提前写洛阳的皇帝仪仗。

sources.title: 后汉书
sources.notes: 铜马降者称其推赤心置人腹中

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画新 · 东汉「铜马」（刘秀在河北）。时间公元 24 年，更始二年。地点与格局：河北、鄡。人物：刘秀（萧王）、铜马部众（河北义军）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "铜马" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: Hebei.  Figures: Liu Xiu, Tongma bands. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "铜马" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: Hebei.  Figures: Liu Xiu, Tongma bands. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 射虎谷
scenes.subtitle: 段颎破羌
scenes.narrative: 东汉对西羌的战争打了几十年，段颎主张把兵力用尽，反对朝里“招降省费”的办法。建宁二年，他把东羌追进射虎谷，在山谷上下设防，最后把这支羌人军队击破。《后汉书》对他的评价很分裂：军功写得很满，杀人的规模也写得很满。本场取山谷、长墙和相持，不把史书里的斩首数字画成风景。这和窦宪燕然勒石不是同一场北边的战争。

sources.title: 后汉书
sources.notes: 建宁二年追羌至射虎谷，大破之

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌）。时间169 年，汉灵帝建宁二年。地点与格局：射虎谷。人物：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: Shehu Valley.  Figures: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌），地点射虎谷，人物剪影：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han, at Shehu Valley. Silhouettes: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌），地点射虎谷，人物剪影：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han, at Shehu Valley. Silhouettes: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 石亭之战
scenes.subtitle: 陆逊破曹休

when.era: 魏太和二年 · 吴黄武七年

scenes.narrative: 魏将曹休听信吴人周鲂的诈降，率兵深入皖地。陆逊在石亭设伏，三路齐进，曹休的军队自相践踏，弃甲逃走。孙权事先还把这支大军的中路交给陆逊统一调度。这是夷陵之后陆逊又一次把追击写成伏击的仗，也是吴国在江北能打赢的少数会战之一。本场画皖口的山道和弃在路上的旗帜，不画刀剑相交。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画三国「石亭之战」（陆逊破曹休）。时间228 年，魏太和二年 · 吴黄武七年。地点与格局：石亭、皖。人物：陆逊（吴大都督）、曹休（魏大司马）、周鲂（吴将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "石亭之战" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Shiting.  Figures: Lu Xun, Cao Xiu, Zhou Fang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 寿春之战
scenes.subtitle: 诸葛诞

when.era: 魏甘露二年 · 吴太平二年

scenes.narrative: 诸葛诞在寿春联结吴国，反对司马氏。司马昭挟魏帝东征，围城一年多。城中粮尽，诸葛诞的部将互相残杀，吴将文钦也被诞杀掉。城破之后，司马氏在淮南的反对者基本清掉。这是一场围城，不是野战：长围、外援进不来、城里先乱。它也说明三国末年的大战已经常常是朝廷内斗打到边镇。本场以寿春的城墙和城外的长围为主。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画三国「寿春之战」（诸葛诞）。时间257 年，魏甘露二年 · 吴太平二年。地点与格局：寿春。人物：司马昭（魏权臣）、诸葛诞（魏征东大将军）、文钦（吴将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "寿春之战" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Shouchun.  Figures: Sima Zhao, Zhuge Dan, Wen Qin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是三国「寿春之战」（诸葛诞），地点寿春，人物剪影：司马昭（魏权臣）、诸葛诞（魏征东大将军）、文钦（吴将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "寿春之战" in the Three Kingdoms, at Shouchun. Silhouettes: Sima Zhao, Zhuge Dan, Wen Qin. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：三国「寿春之战」（诸葛诞），司马昭（魏权臣）、诸葛诞（魏征东大将军）、文钦（吴将），寿春。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "寿春之战" in the Three Kingdoms, Sima Zhao, Zhuge Dan, Wen Qin, Shouchun. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 参合陂
scenes.subtitle: 拓跋珪破慕容宝

when.era: 东晋太元二十年 · 北魏登国十年

scenes.narrative: 后燕慕容宝率大军伐魏，拓跋珪把燕军引到参合陂。燕人觉得魏军已经远走，夜晚不设防。魏军清晨从陂上压下来，燕军溃乱，落水和被俘的人极多。慕容宝单骑逃走。这一仗让北魏从草原部落变成能吃掉中原边镇的力量，后燕从此一蹶不振。《魏书》和《晋书·慕容垂载记》都写了，细节互有出入，本场取双方都承认的结果：燕军在陂下崩了。

sources.title: 魏书
sources.notes: 登国十年破慕容宝于参合陂

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画两晋「参合陂」（拓跋珪破慕容宝）。时间395 年，东晋太元二十年 · 北魏登国十年。地点与格局：参合陂。人物：拓跋珪（魏王）、慕容宝（燕太子）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "参合陂" in the Jin. Place and layout: Canhe Slope.  Figures: Tuoba Gui, Murong Bao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画两晋「参合陂」（拓跋珪破慕容宝）。时间395 年，东晋太元二十年 · 北魏登国十年。地点与格局：参合陂。人物：拓跋珪（魏王）、慕容宝（燕太子）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "参合陂" in the Jin. Place and layout: Canhe Slope.  Figures: Tuoba Gui, Murong Bao. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "参合陂" in the Jin, at Canhe Slope. Silhouettes: Tuoba Gui, Murong Bao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 钟离之战
scenes.subtitle: 邵阳洲

when.era: 梁天监六年 · 魏正始四年

scenes.narrative: 北魏中山王元英围梁国钟离，在淮水上的邵阳洲架桥，兵号称很盛。城中守将昌义之用泥补被炮石打坏的城垛。梁武帝先派曹景宗，再派韦叡赶去。韦叡的军队连夜筑营，火攻洲上的桥。魏军从桥上退下时互相拥挤，淮水为之不流是史书的夸张说法，至少说明溃退发生在水上。钟离因此成为南朝少数守住了的江淮重镇。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南北朝「钟离之战」（邵阳洲）。时间507 年，梁天监六年 · 魏正始四年。地点与格局：钟离、邵阳洲。人物：韦叡（梁将）、昌义之（梁太守）、元英（魏中山王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "钟离之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Zhongli and Shaoyang Island.  Figures: Wei Rui, Chang Yizhi, Yuan Ying. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南北朝「钟离之战」（邵阳洲），地点钟离、邵阳洲，人物剪影：韦叡（梁将）、昌义之（梁太守）、元英（魏中山王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "钟离之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Zhongli and Shaoyang Island. Silhouettes: Wei Rui, Chang Yizhi, Yuan Ying. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「钟离之战」（邵阳洲）。时间507 年，梁天监六年 · 魏正始四年。地点与格局：钟离、邵阳洲。人物：韦叡（梁将）、昌义之（梁太守）、元英（魏中山王）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "钟离之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Zhongli and Shaoyang Island.  Figures: Wei Rui, Chang Yizhi, Yuan Ying. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 沙苑之战
scenes.subtitle: 宇文泰以寡击众

when.era: 西魏大统三年 · 东魏天平四年

scenes.narrative: 高欢的东魏军队渡河，号称兵多。宇文泰的西魏兵少，在沙苑的芦苇荡里把部队分成左右埋伏。东魏兵看见西魏人少，争着向前，队形散了，伏兵从芦苇里出来，东魏大败，丢掉大量甲仗。沙苑让西魏在关中站住，东西对峙从此成为定局。本场用芦苇、河滩和稀疏的西魏旗帜，不把后来隋唐的府兵制度提前画出来。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南北朝「沙苑之战」（宇文泰以寡击众）。时间537 年，西魏大统三年 · 东魏天平四年。地点与格局：沙苑、渭水。人物：宇文泰（西魏丞相）、高欢（东魏权臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "沙苑之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Shayuan.  Figures: Yuwen Tai, Gao Huan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "沙苑之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Shayuan. Silhouettes: Yuwen Tai, Gao Huan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 韩陵之战
scenes.subtitle: 高欢破尔朱

when.era: 北魏普泰二年 · 中兴二年

scenes.narrative: 尔朱氏在河阴之后控制洛阳，高欢从山东起兵，在韩陵山下列阵。他的兵是鲜卑和六镇余部混编的，阵圆之后把牛驴连起来堵住自己的退路，表示不胜就回不去。尔朱兆等几路人马配合不好，被高欢击破。尔朱氏的霸权到此结束，高欢开始成为东魏的实际主人。本场画韩陵山下的圆阵和被拴住的辎重，不画洛阳城里后来的政治清洗。

sources.title: 北齐书
sources.notes: 普泰二年韩陵破尔朱兆

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南北朝「韩陵之战」（高欢破尔朱）。时间532 年，北魏普泰二年 · 中兴二年。地点与格局：韩陵。人物：高欢（晋州刺史）、尔朱兆（尔朱氏）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Figures: Gao Huan, Erzhu Zhao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 浅水原
scenes.subtitle: 薛举父子
scenes.narrative: 武德元年，薛举从金城东进，在浅水原打败唐军，李世民因为生病没有亲自把整场仗管住。薛举不久病死，儿子薛仁杲继续围折墌。李世民先坚壁，等对方粮尽气衰，再在浅水原出击，追到折墌城下，薛仁杲投降。同一块原，先败后胜，旧唐书把两次都记在这一年。本场按时间画两阵之间的空营，不把后来的玄武门提前进来。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 武德元年浅水原败薛举、降薛仁杲

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「浅水原」（薛举父子）。时间618 年，唐武德元年。地点与格局：浅水原、折墌。人物：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "浅水原" in the Tang. Place and layout: Qianshuiyuan.  Figures: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「浅水原」（薛举父子）。时间618 年，唐武德元年。地点与格局：浅水原、折墌。人物：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "浅水原" in the Tang. Place and layout: Qianshuiyuan.  Figures: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「浅水原」（薛举父子），地点浅水原、折墌，人物剪影：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "浅水原" in the Tang, at Qianshuiyuan. Silhouettes: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 安市
scenes.subtitle: 贞观征辽
scenes.narrative: 贞观十九年，唐太宗亲自东征高丽。安市城外，高延寿、高惠真的援军被李世民击破，但安市城本身久攻不下。秋天草枯水冻，唐军退兵，太宗把失败归到自己不该亲自远征。两唐书没有“一将守城、皇帝受挫于某人姓名”的传奇说法，那些姓名是后来的小说。本场只画辽东的土城、城外的唐营和向西撤回的道路。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 贞观十九年攻安市，班师

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「安市」（贞观征辽）。时间645 年，唐太宗贞观十九年。地点与格局：安市、辽东。人物：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "安市" in the Tang. Place and layout: Anshi, Liaodong.  Figures: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「安市」（贞观征辽），地点安市、辽东，人物剪影：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "安市" in the Tang, at Anshi, Liaodong. Silhouettes: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「安市」（贞观征辽）。时间645 年，唐太宗贞观十九年。地点与格局：安市、辽东。人物：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "安市" in the Tang. Place and layout: Anshi, Liaodong.  Figures: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 香积寺
scenes.subtitle: 收复长安
scenes.narrative: 马嵬之后肃宗在灵武即位，郭子仪、李嗣业等从凤翔反攻长安。至德二载九月，唐军和回纥兵在香积寺北与安守忠、李归仁接战，把叛军赶进长安城，当晚长安收复。史书强调的是城西的会战和回纥骑兵从侧翼加入，不是巷战的细节。本场画香积寺外的平原和向城门退去的旗帜。杨贵妃之死已经在马嵬一场里，这里不再重复。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 至德二载香积寺之战，收复长安

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「香积寺」（收复长安）。时间757 年，唐肃宗至德二载。地点与格局：香积寺、长安。人物：郭子仪（唐副元帅）、李嗣业（唐将）、安守忠（燕将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "香积寺" in the Tang. Place and layout: Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an.  Figures: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「香积寺」（收复长安），地点香积寺、长安，人物剪影：郭子仪（唐副元帅）、李嗣业（唐将）、安守忠（燕将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "香积寺" in the Tang, at Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an. Silhouettes: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 河阳之战
scenes.subtitle: 李光弼
scenes.narrative: 乾元二年，史思明在相州打败九节度的联军之后南下。李光弼放弃洛阳，把军队收缩到河阳的三城，背靠黄河，用城北、中潬和南城互相支援。史思明攻城不利，自己在河清被射伤。河阳没有把叛军消灭，但把东都空出来换了一条守得住的河防线。本场画黄河里的中潬城和两岸的栅栏，不画洛阳宫殿里的宴饮。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「河阳之战」（李光弼）。时间759 年，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：河阳、中潬。人物：李光弼（唐太尉）、史思明（燕帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "河阳之战" in the Tang. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort.  Figures: Li Guangbi, Shi Siming. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "河阳之战" in the Tang. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 柏乡之战
scenes.subtitle: 晋破后梁

when.era: 后梁开平五年 · 乾化元年

scenes.narrative: 后梁王景仁率兵北上，在柏乡和高邑之间与晋王李存勖对峙。周德威劝李存勖先退到高邑，让梁军离开营栅、人马饥渴，再反击。梁军果然被引出，晋军用骑兵把他们切碎。柏乡之战让河朔的天平从梁转到晋，也是李存勖从父亲的三支箭故事走进真正会战的一仗。本场画冬天的原野和梁军丢下的营栅。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画五代十国「柏乡之战」（晋破后梁）。时间911 年，后梁开平五年 · 乾化元年。地点与格局：柏乡、高邑。人物：李存勖（晋王）、周德威（晋将）、王景仁（后梁将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "柏乡之战" in the Five Dynasties. Place and layout: Baixiang.  Figures: Li Cunxu, Zhou Dewei, Wang Jingren. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是五代十国「柏乡之战」（晋破后梁），地点柏乡、高邑，人物剪影：李存勖（晋王）、周德威（晋将）、王景仁（后梁将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "柏乡之战" in the Five Dynasties, at Baixiang. Silhouettes: Li Cunxu, Zhou Dewei, Wang Jingren. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "柏乡之战" in the Five Dynasties, Li Cunxu, Zhou Dewei, Wang Jingren, Baixiang. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 高梁河
scenes.subtitle: 宋辽首次大战

when.era: 宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年

scenes.narrative: 太平兴国四年，宋太宗灭北汉后不停脚，直接去攻辽南京。城下宋军已经疲敝。辽将耶律沙在高梁河与宋军接触，耶律休哥和耶律斜轸随后赶到，宋师大溃，太宗连夜退走，与主力失散。《宋史》对这场败写得含糊，《辽史·景宗纪》把追击写得更明白。本场以辽史能对上的结果为准：南京城北的河岸，宋军向南溃退。

sources.title: 辽史
sources.notes: 乾亨元年高梁河破宋师

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 太平兴国四年北伐幽州，师还

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "高梁河" in the Northern Song, at Gaoliang River, near Yanjing. Silhouettes: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战）。时间979 年，宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年。地点与格局：高梁河、南京。人物：宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "高梁河" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Gaoliang River, near Yanjing.  Figures: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 定川寨
scenes.subtitle: 庆历西夏

when.era: 宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年

scenes.narrative: 好水川的第二年，李元昊再次入宋边。宋将葛怀敏在定川寨被夏军包围，夜里溃围，本人死在乱军里。夏军进到渭州，在城下大掠后退走。范仲淹、韩琦在西北的防守并没有因为一次败仗就撤掉，但定川说明宋军出寨会战仍然容易被引进伏地。本场和好水川分开：换了主将、换了寨名，仍是同一条边境上的第二次大败。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏）。时间1042 年，宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年。地点与格局：定川寨、渭州。人物：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "定川寨" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Dingchuan Fort.  Figures: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏），地点定川寨、渭州，人物剪影：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "定川寨" in the Northern Song, at Dingchuan Fort. Silhouettes: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 顺昌之战
scenes.subtitle: 刘锜

when.era: 宋绍兴十年 · 金天眷三年

scenes.narrative: 绍兴十年金军毁约南下。刘锜刚到顺昌，就地筑羊马垣，把船只沉了表示不走。完颜宗弼的重甲骑兵攻城，刘锜在城下设伏，又趁大雨后的暑热出击。金军退走，顺昌保住。这是岳飞北伐同一年里、由另一支军队打的守城战，不能并进朱仙镇的故事里。本场画顺昌的矮墙、城河和城外停住的金军旗帜。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「顺昌之战」（刘锜）。时间1140 年，宋绍兴十年 · 金天眷三年。地点与格局：顺昌。人物：刘锜（宋将）、完颜宗弼（金都元帅）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "顺昌之战" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Shunchang.  Figures: Liu Qi, Wanyan Zongbi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 陈家岛
scenes.subtitle: 李宝焚舟

when.era: 宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年

scenes.narrative: 海陵王南侵时，金朝水军从密州一带南下。李宝率宋朝舟师北上，在胶西陈家岛附近发现金船还挂着帆、士兵多不习水。宋军趁风放火，金舟大半被烧，赴海的人很多。这一仗和虞允文的采石几乎同时，一个在黄海之滨，一个在长江。本场只取陈家岛的船队和火，不把采石的陆军混进来，也不画近代舰船。

figures.name: 李宝
figures.role: 宋浙西路马步军副总管

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 绍兴三十一年陈家岛焚金舟

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟）。时间1161 年，宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年。地点与格局：陈家岛、胶西。人物：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "陈家岛" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Chenjia Island.  Figures: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟），地点陈家岛、胶西，人物剪影：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "陈家岛" in the Southern Song, at Chenjia Island. Silhouettes: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.
